name: carry-estate-waits
what: The estate's page on the tour's Wed Mar 27 (ADR 0026 §6, second step): the day is Evidence feeds' to decide, and the sheet's head links to the page the site has for that flow

.vf-detail .vf-whose: Evidence feeds’ to decide: access_reviews holds. Larkspur estate waits on it.

name: carry-estate-flow
what: The flow's sheet on the estate's page: its own page is a tap away, beside the way into it and its month

name: carry-feeds-unread
what: Evidence feeds' own page, opened on the same day: the same flow on the same files, with a record of its own. A file of Inventory's that only the estate reads: on this page no step reads it, and its Data tab says so

text: No step of this flow reads this file, so a run here doesn’t read it.

name: carry-feeds-month
what: Its own month: the tour's two months as far as they are this flow's, the same days held by the same files, one still waiting

name: carry-feeds-about
what: About this flow names the flow that reads it, a tap from its page, and says the day is decided once

#flow-pages: A paused day is decided once, at the flow that holds: decided on either page, it is carried to the other.

name: carry-feeds-ontology
what: Its Ontology page: the estate's ontology as far as it is about this flow's datasets; a type whose objects are a file no step here reads shows no count, and nothing fails

name: carry-feeds-held
what: The same day is held by the same file, its own to decide, and the sheet says the estate's page takes the decision from here

.vf-detail .vf-whose: Larkspur estate reads this flow: a decision made here is carried there.

name: carry-feeds-decides
what: Decided once, at its flow, on the flow's own page: not published; the receipt says the estate's page takes the decision, a tap away

#loads .vf-rc-taken: Carried to Larkspur estate’s page when the day runs there.

name: carry-estate-carried
what: Back on the estate's page, the day runs, holds, and takes the decision made on Evidence feeds' page: not published, nobody asked, and the receipt says where it was decided

#loads .vf-rc-carried: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.

name: carry-estate-record
what: The estate's record: the file's decision is Evidence feeds', carried from its page and citing its entry there; the posture's own load carries that one, as inside one page

#record: carried from Evidence feeds’ page, its #

name: carry-estate-month
what: The month's day picked tells it in order: held, then decided on Evidence feeds' page and carried here

#view-month .mo-sum: On Evidence feeds’ page, Owner kept it back: nothing was published for the day. Carried here.

name: carry-back-amends
what: The other way: the decision is changed on the estate's page, at Evidence feeds, where its file holds: published as is after all, with a reason, amending the one it carried; the receipt says Evidence feeds' page takes it

#loads .vf-rc-taken: Carried to Evidence feeds’ page when the day runs there.

name: carry-estate-audit
what: The estate's record exported for audit, with a decision it carried and its own change of it: the bag carries the proof of the decision it cites, and the offline audit holds it without Evidence feeds' record

name: carry-back-amended
what: Evidence feeds' own page carries the change in turn: the flow's latest decision stands on both pages, its own earlier one amended, and its own page asks nobody; the receipt says where it was decided

#loads .vf-rc-carried: Decided on Larkspur estate’s page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.

name: carry-back-record
what: Evidence feeds' record cites the estate's entry

#record: carried from Larkspur estate’s page, its #

name: carry-back-audit
what: Evidence feeds' record exported for audit: each decision of its own flow says the flow as kept, the one carried from the estate's page is proved from the estate's record, and the offline audit holds the bag
